input.story: Bhai maine 8 October 2026 ko UPI se 15000 bheje, paise account se kat gaye par receiver ko nahi mile. Bank ko complaint ki, 3 hafte ho gaye koi jawab nahi. Kya karun?

output.masked_story: Bhai maine 8 October 2026 ko UPI se 15000 bheje, paise account se kat gaye par receiver ko nahi mile. Bank ko complaint ki, 3 hafte ho gaye koi jawab nahi. Kya karun?

case.problem_subtype: failed UPI transaction refund not processed
case.summary: The user transferred 15000 rupees via UPI on 8 October 2026, but the amount was debited from their account and not credited to the receiver. They filed a complaint with the bank three weeks ago, but have received no response yet.
case.user_goal: Get the failed UPI transaction amount refunded by the bank

timeline.event: Transferred 15000 via UPI, money debited from account but not received by receiver

follow_up_questions: Aap kaunse state mein rehte hain?
Kya aapke paas bank complaint number ya acknowledgment hai?
Kya UPI transaction ID ya screenshot available hai?

notes: A Consumer Commission can also award compensation and litigation costs - we don't estimate that figure; it depends on the case.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_you_stand: Aapka Rs 15,000 ka failed UPI transaction ka case kaafi strong hai kyunki aapke paas bank account statement se debit ka proof mil sakta hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Bank ko 3 haftay pehle complaint bhejne ke baad bhi reply na dena deficiency in service maana jaata hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Yeh achhi baat hai ki aapke paas time hai aur aap Consumer Protection Act ke antargat complain kar sakte hain [KB:cpa_limitation]. Lekin abhi aapke paas transaction reference ID / screenshot aur bank complaint ki copy missing hai, jise aapko jald se jald ikattha karna hoga.

options.title: Bank aur National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch] par follow-up
options.what_to_do: Apne bank se complaint acknowledgment number maangein aur National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch] (1915 ya consumerhelpline.gov.in) par complaint darj karein.

options.title: RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026] par complaint
options.what_to_do: Agar bank 30 din ke andar jawab nahi deta ya reject karta hai, toh RBI ke online portal (cms.rbi.org.in) par free mein complaint file karein.

options.title: District Consumer Commission mein shikayat
options.what_to_do: Agar wahan bhi solution na mile, toh e-Jagriti portal par online consumer complaint darj karein [KB:forum_ejagriti]. Rs 5 lakh tak ke case ke liye koi court fee nahi hai [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh].

proof_tips: Apne bank app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm ya banking app) ki history mein jaakar transaction ID ka screenshot lein.
Bank statement PDF download karein jisme Rs 15,000 debit hone ki entry saaf dikhe.
Agar email ya SMS par bank complaint ki koi copy mili ho, toh use safe rakhein.
what_i_dont_know: Exact UPI transaction reference ID aur bank complaint ka acknowledgment number kya hai.
Kya bank ne aapki pehli complaint par koi internal status update diya hai ya nahi.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: Yeh ek simple failed UPI transaction ka refund case hai jise aap khud National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch] aur RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026] ke zariye bina kisi lawyer ke solve kar sakte hain.
assessment.reply: Namaste! Aapka Rs 15,000 ka failed UPI transaction ka mamla kaafi clear hai. Bank dwara 3 hafte tak jawab na dena deficiency in service kehlata hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Abhi sabse pehle aapko National Consumer Helpline (1915 ya consumerhelpline.gov.in) par free mein complaint karni chahiye [KB:forum_nch]. Agar wahan se baat na bane, toh RBI Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in) par complain kar sakte hain kyunki banking transactions ke liye yeh bahut bada zariya hai [KB:rbi_ios_2026]. Isme kisi lawyer ki zaroorat nahi hai aur koi court fee bhi nahi lagti [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh]. Kya aapke paas abhi wo UPI transaction ID ya screenshot aur bank statement available hai?
